title: "BUG: Bad page state in process Compositor" after update to 6.13.1
body: Update: Seems to be an issue with the kernel or Arch's packaging of it: https://gitlab.archlinux.org/archlinux/ … issues/110 --- Ran a system update which had updated my kernel from 6.12.10 to 6.13.1. Computer was unusable after a while of running; could not close my web browser, the currently opened terminal emulator could not launch most new processes.. etc. btop for example could launch but it would show nothing inside it, almost as if /proc wasn't accessible anymore.
